title: Routine relies on signed-integer overflow wraparound — undefined behavior
notes:
Classic UB trap. C++ standard [expr.ass]/p1 says signed-integer
overflow is UB; the compiler may delete the entire loop body if it
can prove overflow. .NET / Java translations need either unsigned
int (.NET: uint; Java: explicit & 0xFFFFFFFFL) or a documented choice
to preserve the wraparound semantics. The extraction prompt's rule #5
(UB must be surfaced) is what makes this trap detectable.
